warning.titlePre: Jaguar X-Type 2.0 V6 Ignition Coil Degradation
paragraphs: X-Type V6 engines — AJ20, AJ25 and AJ30, across every X400 generation — commonly show ignition coil degradation over time. This is often accelerated by oil contamination from leaking valve cover gaskets. We replace ignition coils and valve cover gaskets as standard on every rebuild.
warning.source: Source: verified via multiple independent sources (CarChecker.pro, TrueDelta, per G-BRF, confirmed in earlier session).
